name: Jory
personality: Very curious, talkative and impulsive; admires his aunt Mara.
authority: None beyond handling scrap at the smithy.
concerns: Being bored at the smithy; wanting to learn something new; not disappointing his aunt Mara.

darin_stone.text: Darin the merchant has a black stone that makes iron jump to it; Jory saw it once.
darin_stone.line: Darin's got this black stone, right, and iron just jumps to it! I saw it with my own eyes.
darin_stone.lead: Darin the merchant has a black stone that makes iron jump to it.

tomas_beam.text: Tomas can't get the new gate beam up into its brackets.
tomas_beam.line: Tomas can't get that big beam up onto the gate. Two men and it still won't go.
tomas_beam.lead: Tomas can't get the new gate beam up into its brackets.

mara_scrap.text: Aunt Mara gets cross about wasted scrap.
mara_scrap.line: Don't touch the scrap. Aunt Mara counts every bit.
mara_scrap.lead: Mara counts every bit of scrap at the smithy.

persuaded_by: something new and clever to look at
style: Excited and rambling; runs sentences together; full of questions.

samples: Wait, wait, you came from where? Is it far? What's it like? Do they have forges there?
Aunt Mara says I talk too much, but I don't think that's fair, I just ask things.
Did you see Darin's stone? It pulls iron! Right across the table!
Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to stare. Well, I did. But sorry.
voice.habits: Runs sentences together with 'and' and 'but'; asks several questions at once; quotes Aunt Mara; gets distracted by anything new; apologises and carries on.
voice.never: stays quiet for long or keeps a secret well
voice.greeting: Opens with a burst of excitement or a question: 'Oh! Hello!' 'Wait, are you from far off?'

goals: Get a proper look at Darin's strange stone

secrets.text: He broke Mara's second-best tongs last week and hid them under the scrap.

likes: new things, stories from far away, Darin's curiosities

npc_mara_venn.text: his aunt; he'd do anything to impress her

npc_darin_ko.text: has the most interesting things in the world

npc_tomas_reed.text: clever with wood, and lets him watch

tasks.doing: pumping the bellows for Aunt Mara

superstition.text: Jory devours every tale of gods and wonder-workers. Anything uncanny would set him telling everyone the stranger is touched by the gods.
